title: A test game on an engine I'm building. C++20, DirectX 12 and Vulkan, from scratch.
author: MAuraEngine
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1wn523j/video/9ik7toqpl1rh1/player

    I don't write the code. I decide what goes in and whether it looks right.

    What I gave it: the Synty Apocalypse city pack, a SideKick modular character, and

    a description. Something like the Bow Combat demo Synty has on itch, but set in

    the city, with zombies walking at you instead of targets. Two minutes of typing.

    The first playable version came out of that. Bow, free aim over the shoulder,

    twelve zombies pathfinding on a navmesh in the imported city.

    What you're watching is the fourth pass. Each pass was me playing it and saying

    what felt wrong, never me writing code. Shooting while walking. Strafing while

    aiming without the character turning to face where it walks. The arrow staying

    stuck in the zombie and going down with the body. And the last one, which is the

    one that fixed how it looks: the bow moved from a hand position I'd tuned by eye

    to the socket the animator left in the clips, with the bow model rigged, so the

    string tenses as the character draws.
